summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Car Wash Booking System. All backend APIs pass (15/15 tests). Frontend booking widget fully functional with 4-step flow working correctly. Mobile responsiveness verified - calendar does not overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed HTTPException handling in server.py - was being caught by generic Exception handler and re-raised as 500 instead of 400
seed_data_creation: N/A - using existing Supabase packages data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working: GET /api/packages returns 6 packages (3 interior, 3 exterior), POST /api/bookings/calculate correctly calculates prices with vehicle size fees, POST /api/bookings/available-slots returns time slots based on business hours. Frontend booking widget has 4 steps: 1) Package selection with colored borders (blue for deluxe, amber for ultimate), 2) Service type and vehicle size, 3) Date/time selection with calendar showing SU/MO/TU/WE/TH/FR/SA day names, 4) Customer form with validation. Mobile responsiveness verified - calendar fits within viewport.

backend_apis.GET /api/packages: Returns 6 packages (3 interior: Standard $20, Deluxe $40, Ultimate $60; 3 exterior: Standard $20, Deluxe $35, Ultimate $50)
backend_apis.POST /api/bookings/calculate: Correctly calculates total price with vehicle size fees (Small: free, Medium: +$5, Large: +$10) and duration with 30-min buffer
backend_apis.POST /api/bookings/available-slots: Returns available time slots in 30-minute intervals based on business hours (Mon-Fri 3-6 PM, Sat 10-6 PM, Sun 1-6 PM)
backend_apis.POST /api/bookings/create: Validates required fields and package selection

frontend_features.step1_service_selection: Interior/exterior packages with static colored borders (blue for deluxe, amber for ultimate), checkmarks on selection
frontend_features.step2_service_type_vehicle: Mobile/Drop-off selection, vehicle size with fee display
frontend_features.step3_date_time: Calendar with shortened day names (SU, MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA), time slots appear after date selection, business hours info displayed
frontend_features.step4_customer_form: Name, phone, email, address (for mobile), water/electric checkbox, notes field, validation errors shown
frontend_features.price_duration_display: Price and duration shown on same line as Continue/Confirm button
frontend_features.mobile_responsiveness: Calendar does not overflow on mobile (296px width in 390px viewport)

features_verified.hero_section: No Yelp/Google buttons in hero (only in navbar), Book Appointment and View Services buttons present
